$Comment: Extra Turkeys: hunt Wild Turkeys for Martha as often as a player likes, for those who want to keep
earning her favor past the day's work. It opens once the turkey hunt (harvest_feast_host_2) is done.
An empty Repeat makes it repeatable with nothing holding it back: no cooldown, no daily reset and no
limit, so it is offered again the moment its pay is collected. Npc.TurnInId, from the base, adds the
report-back step to the host after the hunt.
It is offered from Martha's quest list (What needs doing?) and never at her greeting: her
conversation's row for it names only its Active and Ready screens, so the start ladder never opens on
it as an offer. Listing.MainLine is false, so it reads as a side quest. The kills also pay favor on
their own through her reputation's Kills table, so the quest's favor comes on top. Tune its Amount
and its favor together with the Kills Amount if turkeys come faster than planned.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the hunt, waiting to be collected with the rest.
The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod,
unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Extra_Turkeys
